name: queens_guard_aims_at_most_health
description: The Queen's Guard aims at the creep with the most health in its reach (M8's fork pass, "aim": "most_hp"), not at a flier first as every other Apiary does, nor at the creep furthest along: on a mixed line held in its reach, a Gourdling furthest along (24.00), a Duskmoth behind it (30.00) and a Thornback last (80.00), it stings the Thornback until it dies, then the Duskmoth, then the Gourdling; the Royal Apiary on the same line shoots the Duskmoth first (winged first), then the Gourdling (furthest along), then the Thornback. The fork bench measures one creep at a time, so this is where the aim is held.

steps.msg: a Queen's Guard, aiming at the most health

steps.assert: guard_shots.size() >= 4 and guard_shots[0]['target'] == c[2] and guard_shots[1]['target'] == c[2] and guard_shots[2]['target'] == c[1] and guard_shots[3]['target'] == c[0]
steps.msg: it stings the Thornback twice (54 for its 80.00), then the Duskmoth, then the Gourdling furthest along
a Royal Apiary, aiming at fliers first

steps.assert: royal_shots.size() >= 3 and royal_shots[0]['target'] == d[1] and royal_shots[1]['target'] == d[0] and royal_shots[2]['target'] == d[2]
steps.msg: the Royal Apiary shoots the Duskmoth, then the Gourdling furthest along, then the Thornback
